heading: Built around the hours you have

items.title: Focus that defends itself
items.body: Mark the hours you think best in. Sundial holds them, and moves them, never deletes them, when a meeting has to land there.

items.title: Meetings at the edges
items.body: Share a link and people pick from the hours you are least needed in. Your mornings never appear on it.

items.title: A day that ends
items.body: Set when you stop. Anything still on the list rolls to tomorrow at a time it can actually happen.

items.title: Every calendar, one view
items.body: Work, home and the shared family calendar side by side, so nothing double-books you.
